ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the graph of the linear function $y = kx + b$ passes through the point $P\left(-\frac{1}{2}, 1\right)$. What is the solution set of the inequality $kx + b < 1$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} The graph of the linear function $y=kx+b$ passes through the point $P\left( -\frac{1}{2}, 1\right)$.\\
By analyzing the graph, we can find that the solution set of $kx+b<1$ is: $x<-\frac{1}{2}$,\\
Therefore, the answer is: $\boxed{x<-\frac{1}{2}}$.
